run.name: Monday run and social
run.title: Run And Social
run.blurb: Meet at The Architect for a run at your own pace, then stay for the social. Free, always.
run.calendar: A free Monday run followed by a social at The Architect, Chester. All people, all paces, all welcome. The route changes every week. A few favourites come round again, but never more than twice a month. Bring a light on dark nights.

football.name: Thursday football
football.title: Football
football.blurb: Come and play. All people, all paces, all welcome on the pitch too.
football.calendar: Thursday football at Chester University Football Pitches, Parkgate Rd, Chester CH1 4BJ. All people, all paces, all welcome.
